## 882c01c42710

**Reproduced generator/validator defects.** The audit battery failed seven
stages: lint, self-check, defect lint, profile floor, semantic gate, override,
and authority sync. Most directly, `self_check` rejects all **3/3 canonical
pairs** with “horizontal and vertical seed sequences overlap at center
crossing,” even though that occupied crossing is part of the canonical task.
The supported Racket application reproduces the canonical output and matching
rule hash in `checks/audit/882c01c42710/canonical-racket-output.json`.

The public override surface is also materially inert. With fixed seed `42881`,
sample index `7`, and medium difficulty, changing each of `n_h` 3→5, `n_v`
3→5, `anchor_corner` false→true, `asymmetry_force` false→true, and
`palette_kind` warm→cool produced byte-identical grids. Exact inputs, outputs,
generator SHA-256 `500aa698a26013b6dc11d1cbfe4f1d969486f5cf0c6afb233d1de06015b4da80`,
and commands are in `checks/audit/882c01c42710/counterexample.json`. The
battery's override stage reported more than 17,000 findings, and lint also found
missing `RULE_HASH`.

Classification: reproduced defect. The audit target was not modified.
